mapper.sql: SELECT d.agent_id::text, d.version, d.name, d.description, d.roles::text, d.enabled_skills::text, d.skill_bundles::text, d.capability_tags::text, d.overrides::text, d.orchestration::text, d.instructions::text, d.model_ref, d.generation_params::text, d.config_fingerprint, d.schema_version, d.created_at, d.published_at FROM cap_agent_def d
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cap_agent_def (agent_id, version, name, description, roles, enabled_skills, skill_bundles, capability_tags, overrides, orchestration, instructions, model_ref, generation_params, config_fingerprint, schema_version, created_at, updated_at, published_at) VALUES (#{agentId}::uuid, #{version}, #{name}, #{description}, #{roles}::jsonb, #{enabledSkills}::jsonb, #{skillBundles}::jsonb, #{capabilityTags}::jsonb, #{overrides}::jsonb, #{orchestration}::jsonb, #{instructions}::jsonb, #{modelRef}, #{generationParams}::jsonb, #{configFingerprint}, #{schemaVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{publishedAt}) ON CONFLICT (agent_id, version) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WHERE d.agent_id = #{agentId}::uuid AND d.version = #{version} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_agent_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND b.agent_id = d.agent_id AND b.status = 'ACTIVE')

WHERE d.agent_id = #{agentId}::uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_agent_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND b.agent_id = d.agent_id AND b.status = 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY d.version DESC LIMIT 1
WHERE d.agent_id = #{agentId}::uuid ORDER BY d.version DESC LIMIT 1

WHERE d.agent_id = #{agentId}::uuid AND d.published_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_agent_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND b.agent_id = d.agent_id AND b.status = 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY d.version DESC LIMIT 1

JOIN tenant_agent_binding b ON b.agent_id = d.agent_id AND b.tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND b.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE d.version = (SELECT max(d2.version) FROM cap_agent_def d2 WHERE d2.agent_id = d.agent_id) ORDER BY d.agent_id ASC
